title: Chennai to Bangalore Bus: Route Guide, Timing and Travel Tips
summary: Complete Chennai to Bangalore bus guide: 383 km route on zingbus, approx 6h 17m journey, boarding points, timings, fare tips and what to expect on the way.
body_markdown:
The Chennai to Bangalore route is one of South India’s most travelled intercity corridors. Two of the four largest cities in the country, separated by about 383 kilometres of highway, connected by hundreds of daily bus departures across a range of operators and service types. For most travellers on this route, the main decisions are not whether to take the bus but which bus, which departure time, and what to do during the 6-plus hours it takes. This guide covers all of that.


## **Chennai to Bangalore Bus: What This Guide Covers**


This guide covers the distance and journey time for the Chennai to Bangalore bus, what the route looks like, the boarding points and drop-off options, timing structure, what to look for when selecting a bus type, and practical tips for making the journey comfortable. For booking, seat selection, and checking current availability, the[Chennai to Bangalore bus booking page](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/chennai-to-bangalore-bus-route) on zingbus has live schedules, seat maps, and AC options across departure windows.


The Chennai to Bangalore route on zingbus covers approximately 383 km, with the journey taking around 6 hours 17 minutes in typical conditions. zingbus operates three daily services on this corridor, with the first bus departing at 9:35 PM and the last at 10:45 PM, making this primarily an overnight route that delivers passengers into Bangalore in the early morning hours.


# **Chennai to Bangalore by Bus: Route, Timing and Everything You Need to Know**


The road between Chennai and Bangalore is NH44 (formerly NH7), one of India’s longest national highways running from Srinagar to Kanyakumari. The Chennai to Bangalore section is one of the most commercially and industrially active stretches of this highway, passing through the Hosur industrial corridor, which has grown into one of South India’s significant manufacturing zones.


## **Distance and Journey Time**


The Chennai to Bangalore bus distance is approximately 383 km. The journey takes around 6 hours 17 minutes on the zingbus route in normal conditions. Traffic through Chennai city on departure and through Bangalore city on arrival can add time, particularly on evenings when Chennai traffic is heaviest, typically around 6 to 9 PM.


The overnight timing of zingbus departures on this route (from late evening) means that the Chennai city traffic factor is less significant than it would be for a daytime departure. By 9:35 PM when the first bus departs, the worst of the evening traffic has typically passed.


## **The Route: What You Pass Through**


The Chennai to Bangalore route heads southwest from Chennai. After clearing the city limits through the OMR and Kelambakkam direction, or the GST Road depending on the departure point, the highway runs toward Krishnagiri, which is the major midpoint town at approximately 200 km from Chennai.


From Krishnagiri, the road continues through Hosur, the rapidly industrialising town that sits just across the Tamil Nadu-Karnataka state border. Hosur is the last significant settlement before the highway approaches Bangalore, and many tech and manufacturing campuses line this stretch. The final approach into Bangalore via Electronic City and then into the city is typically the section where journey time becomes most variable depending on the time of arrival.


The landscape along this route is the Deccan plateau: relatively flat, with the occasional rocky elevation typical of South India’s interior. It does not have the dramatic geography of a Himalayan or Western Ghats route, but the smooth highway and the overnight timing mean most passengers are asleep through the middle section.


## **Chennai to Bangalore Bus Timings and Boarding Points**


zingbus currently operates three services on the Chennai to Bangalore route. Departure timings for the most current schedules are on the[live Chennai to Bangalore route page](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/chennai-to-bangalore-bus-route) , since specific timing can shift based on season and operational scheduling.


The overnight departure structure means that the bus leaves Chennai in the late evening and arrives in Bangalore in the early morning hours, typically before 6 AM. For travellers whose destination in Bangalore is the city centre or northern areas, this timing allows an early start on arrival day without needing a full hotel night.


Boarding points for Chennai to Bangalore buses typically include locations in multiple city zones to reduce the commute from different parts of Chennai. The zingbus booking process shows available boarding points for each specific departure when selecting a trip.


## **Bus Type Options on the Chennai to Bangalore Route**


The Chennai to Bangalore route carries a range of bus types from basic AC seater to sleeper and semi-sleeper configurations. For a journey of approximately 6 hours 17 minutes, a semi-sleeper or AC seater is a practical choice for most travellers, since the overnight timing means arriving in Bangalore before significant morning sleep disruption.


Sleeper buses on this route are appropriate for travellers who want to lie flat for the full journey duration, particularly those with early arrival plans who want maximum rest. The route length of around 6 hours is at the lower end of where a full sleeper berth becomes essential, but for travellers with back concerns or those who sleep better flat, it is worth the additional cost.


The fare on this route starts from approximately Rs 373 based on current zingbus data, with higher prices for upgraded seat types and premium buses. Prices are subject to change based on demand, season, and booking timing.


Note: Prices are approximate and may vary based on season, demand, and availability.


## **Chennai to Bangalore Bus Duration and What Affects It**


The standard chennai to bangalore bus duration of approximately 6 hours 17 minutes assumes normal highway conditions. Several factors can extend this:


The Chennai departure window matters. Buses departing between 6 and 9 PM from Chennai city core may encounter peak evening traffic before reaching the highway. The late evening departures from around 9 to 11 PM face lighter city traffic.


The Hosur bottleneck is a frequent slowing point, particularly on Mondays when traffic from the weekend converges on the Bangalore approach. The industrial activity along the Hosur corridor also contributes to heavy vehicle density on this stretch.


Rain during the monsoon months (June to September) adds time to this route, as it does to most South Indian highway journeys. October, when this blog is most relevant, is the post-monsoon period and generally sees better conditions.


## **Practical Tips for the Chennai to Bangalore Bus Journey**


The overnight structure means the journey works best when you board without having a heavy meal immediately before departure. Light eating before boarding and having a bag with water and a small snack for the journey is the practical approach.


A window seat on this route is a matter of preference rather than a scenic imperative: the highway at night offers limited visibility and the view is not a primary reason to take the bus on this corridor. The more practical seat preference is an aisle seat if you want easier access during the journey, or a window seat if you prefer to lean against it while sleeping.


Carry a light jacket. AC buses on overnight South India routes often run the air conditioning on the cooler side, and the early morning arrival in Bangalore between 4 and 6 AM can feel cold regardless of the season.


Phone charging facilities are available on most zingbus services. Carry a charged power bank as a backup, particularly if your phone is essential for navigation on arrival.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What is the distance from Chennai to Bangalore by bus?**


The Chennai to Bangalore bus distance is approximately 383 km via NH44, with the journey taking around 6 hours 17 minutes in normal road conditions.


### **How long does the Chennai to Bangalore bus take?**


The Chennai to Bangalore bus journey takes approximately 6 hours 17 minutes on zingbus in typical conditions; traffic on departure from Chennai and the approach into Bangalore can add time, particularly on evening departures from the city.


### **What are the Chennai to Bangalore bus timings on zingbus?**


zingbus operates three services on the Chennai to Bangalore route; the first bus departs at 9:35 PM and the last at 10:45 PM, making this primarily an overnight route with early morning arrivals in Bangalore.


### **What is the fare for the Chennai to Bangalore bus?**


The Chennai to Bangalore bus fare on zingbus starts from approximately Rs 373 for standard AC options, with higher prices for premium bus types; prices are approximate and may vary based on season, demand, and availability.


### **Which highway does the Chennai to Bangalore bus take?**


The Chennai to Bangalore bus travels on NH44, formerly known as NH7, passing through Krishnagiri and Hosur before entering Bangalore via the Electronic City approach.


### **What are the boarding points for the Chennai to Bangalore bus?**


Chennai to Bangalore bus boarding points are shown during the zingbus booking process for each specific departure; multiple city zone pickup points are typically available to reduce the commute from different parts of Chennai.


### **Is there an overnight bus from Chennai to Bangalore?**


Yes, zingbus operates overnight buses from Chennai to Bangalore with evening departures starting at 9:35 PM; the buses arrive in Bangalore in the early morning hours, typically before 6 AM.


### **What bus types are available on the Chennai to Bangalore route?**


The Chennai to Bangalore route is served by AC seater, semi-sleeper, and sleeper bus configurations; the approximately 6-hour journey makes a semi-sleeper a practical choice for most overnight travellers, with sleeper berths available for those who prefer lying flat.


### **What is the best time to book the Chennai to Bangalore bus?**


Booking 3 to 5 days in advance is sufficient for weekday travel; Friday evening and weekend departures see higher demand and earlier booking is recommended; the overnight departure window typically fills faster than daytime options.


### **Does the Chennai to Bangalore bus pass through any major cities?**


The Chennai to Bangalore bus route passes through Krishnagiri at approximately 200 km from Chennai and Hosur near the Tamil Nadu-Karnataka border; neither is a major city stop, and the route is largely a direct highway connection between the two endpoints.
